title: A call signal's participantId carried a user URI, which is not a JMAP Id, and the failure was swallowed by .ok()
design:
FOUND 2026-11-25 by bead mimid-1wgh.114.10's test, after the two bugs
above it were fixed. The third of three in one path, and the one the
bead predicted when it said a browser demo "reports no audio" where this
test "reports which one".

WHAT HAPPENED. vtc_stream::signal_of built the VTCCallSignal with

    "participantId": sender,

where `sender` is the authenticated MLS sender's USER URI, e.g.
mimi://a.example/u/alice. VtcCallSignal::participant_id is a
jmap_types::Id, and RFC 8620 §1.2 allows no `:` or `/` in an Id, so
serde_json::from_value refused the object every time.

AND NOTHING SAID SO, because the function ended in

    .ok()

which turned the refusal into `None`, which the pump treats as "this
subscription does not cover this signal" and skips with `continue`. A
signal that could not be built was indistinguishable from one the client
had filtered out. Three different causes — no projected call, a refused
subscription, an unbuildable event — all looked identical from outside:
silence.

THE FIX, two parts.

1. `participantId` is the Id a client already has for that person: the
   account's own id when the sender is this user, else the person's store
   key, which is exactly what ChatMember.id carries
   (`render::Render::known_id`). A client correlates a signal to a chat
   member by it. A sender this agent has no person record for yields
   None, which is a signal from someone it has never seen in a room.
2. The `.ok()` becomes a match that logs at ERROR
   (`agent_call_signal_undeliverable`). An event that will not build is a
   call that does not connect, and the operator should not have to guess.

NOTE FOR THE DRAFT, not a change: draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00
§VTCCallSignal says participantId is "The participant that sent it",
which reads naturally as a VTCParticipant id. mimid serves no
VTCParticipant records yet, so it uses the person id its own clients
already see. If VTCParticipant records are ever projected, this should
move to their ids and the two must not disagree. Worth a sentence in the
draft about which id it is.
